changes.comment: A tab can now be dropped into a tab group from the right: the trailing half of a group's last tab is the tail of that group, the way its chip's trailing half is the head. Joining a one-tab group by drag was impossible before.

Notes drag out of the file navigator into the editor: onto a tab strip the note opens as a tab where you let go (inside a group if you land in one), onto the middle of a pane it opens there, and onto a pane's edge it opens in a new pane beside it.

Manage tab group is now a small popover anchored to the group's own chip instead of a dialog in the middle of the screen: a header row with the colour dot and the name you type straight into, the eight swatches, and the verbs as one icon row each.
